policy.taskId: Stable gh- prefix plus the first 32 hexadecimal characters of actionKey
policy.headAndBaseEvidence: Both commits must exist locally before a task is written
policy.budgetEnforcement: Configured QuotaFlow account budgets remain enforced by the scheduler; configurations without a budget report quota_only
policy.agentPermissions: Prompts forbid push, comments, approvals, merges, and repository settings changes

idempotency.sameActionKey: Returns task_exists without inserting another task or task_created event
idempotency.workspaceHeadDrift: Rejected before returning an existing task
idempotency.parallelAgentActions: Rejected because one plan may create at most one Agent task

livePilotMaterialization.budgetEnforcement: configured in an isolated temporary database

scope.liveAgentExecution: not run; the live pilot stopped after idempotent task materialization
